    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        theta0 = state_variables[0, :]
        p0 = state_variables[1, :]
        theta1 = state_variables[2, :]
        p1 = state_variables[3, :]
        theta2 = state_variables[4, :]
        p2 = state_variables[5, :]

        k0 = self.k0
        k1 = self.k1
        k2 = self.k2
        Gamma = self.Gamma

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)

        # Derived Variables

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.

            np.asarray(
                np.mod(
                    p0
                    + theta0
                    + k0 * np.sin(theta0)
                    - Gamma * (-np.sin(theta0 - theta1) - np.sin(theta0 - theta2)),
                    2 * np.pi,
                )
            ),  # theta0
            np.asarray(
                np.mod(
                    p0
                    + k0 * np.sin(theta0)
                    - Gamma * (-np.sin(theta0 - theta1) - np.sin(theta0 - theta2)),
                    2 * np.pi,
                )
            ),  # p0
            np.asarray(
                np.mod(
                    p1
                    + theta1
                    + k1 * np.sin(theta1)
                    - Gamma * (-np.sin(theta1 - theta2) + np.sin(theta0 - theta1)),
                    2 * np.pi,
                )
            ),  # theta1
            np.asarray(
                np.mod(
                    p1
                    + k1 * np.sin(theta1)
                    - Gamma * (-np.sin(theta1 - theta2) + np.sin(theta0 - theta1)),
                    2 * np.pi,
                )
            ),  # p1
            np.asarray(
                np.mod(
                    p2
                    + theta2
                    + k2 * np.sin(theta2)
                    - Gamma * (np.sin(theta0 - theta2) + np.sin(theta1 - theta2)),
                    2 * np.pi,
                )
            ),  # theta2
            np.asarray(
                np.mod(
                    p2
                    + k2 * np.sin(theta2)
                    - Gamma * (np.sin(theta0 - theta2) + np.sin(theta1 - theta2)),
                    2 * np.pi,
                )
            ),  # p2
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
